title: [Informações do servidor] Relics / Upgrade de Relics
bodyHtml:
General informationRelic list and statsHow to get and recycle relicsUpgrading relics
​

GENERAL INFORMATION

  • Relics are unique permanent bonuses that increase your character’s stats and do not take inventory space.
  • Relics are divided into grades. The higher the grade, the stronger the relic.
  • Relics can be upgraded (see below).
  • To activate a relic, you must use* it from your inventory.
    *use it as a potion, but it is not displayed and stays active forever
  • If a character already has a certain relic active, you cannot reuse / reactivate the same relic.
    for example, you cannot have two Dagnue relics active at the same time, etc.
  • Effects from different relics are added together.
    for example, if your Dagnue relic gives 10% force attack and Blink relic gives 5% force attack, the total bonus will be 15% force attack
  • Relics mainly drop from PB, BD, Cartella Quests, and Adventurer Quests.

HOW TO GET AND RECYCLE RELICS

Relics are parts of specific entities.

How to get relics:

Loot them from the entity they belong to (for PB - from PB, for monsters - from monsters, for dungeons - from dungeon rewards, etc.) (tradable)
  • Clarifications for relics that are not from PB or BD:
    • Rank Relics - given as a reward for completing "Box of Dreams" quest chain.
    • (1GR) Heart of Caves Relic - drops from gathering resource Ore Grade 3.
    • (1GR) Heart of Sand Relic - drops from gathering resource Cactus Grade 3.
    • (1GR) Heart of Ice Relic - drops from gathering resource Flowers Grade 3.
    • (1GR) Ice Rift Relic - drops from Rift Caliana.
    • (1GR) Gold Relic - purchased with gold points.
    • (1GR) Greed Relic - purchased with racial currency from NPC Hero in HQ.
    • (3GR) Hunter Cactus Relic - drops from gathering resource Hunter Cactus Grade 3.
    • (4GR) PVP Assassin Relic - purchased with PVP points.
    • (4GR) Terminal Relic - drops as shards from chip.
    • (5GR) Hunter Relic - purchased with Hunting Points.
    • (5GR) Rift Hunter Relic - drops from Desert of Hunters rift.
    • (6GR) Gift of Random Goddess Relic - obtained from a Luck Blade upgraded to +7 keen talics. Luck Blade can be purchased from NPC Hero in HQ.

Obtain from Random Relic Boxes. Boxes also have grades just like relics.
  • You can get Random Relic Boxes from:
    • All relic-related entities with a small chance (tradable). (for example, from PB Dagnue you might get a Dagnue Relic (5GR) or a Random Relic Box Grade 5 [chance to drop a box from an entity is much lower than for the relic itself])
    • From recycling Sealed Relic Parts (not tradable). (see below)
    • From alternate sources (mostly from Cartella Quests and from Adventurer Quests) (not tradable)
    • Exceptions (cannot drop from boxes):
      • Rank Relics
      • (1GR) Gold Relic
      • (1GR) Greed Relic
      • (4GR) PVP Assassin Relic
      • (5GR) Hunter Relic
      • (6GR) Gift of Random Goddess Relic

Relics that were dropped from PB, monsters, BD, or from Random Relic Boxes (those that are TRADABLE) can be listed and bought on the web-auction.


Recycling relics:

Relics can be recycled into Sealed Relic Parts (not tradable) (can be stored in the bank).
Sealed Relic Parts also have grades. Recycling a Grade 1 relic gives a Grade 1 Sealed Relic Part, recycling a Grade 2 relic gives a Grade 2 Sealed Relic Part, and so on.



x3 Sealed Relic Parts of the same grade can be combined into one Random Relic Box of that grade (90%) or a random relic box of the next grade (10%) (not tradable).



Also, Sealed Relic Parts can be recycled into relic dust, which is used for upgrading relics (see below).

Relics that cannot be recycled into Sealed Relic Parts:
  • Rank Relics
  • (1GR) Gold Relic
  • (1GR) Greed Relic
  • (4GR) PVP Assassin Relic
  • (5GR) Hunter Relic
  • (6GR) Gift of Random Goddess Relic

UPGRADING RELICS

Navigation for relic upgrade menu:

Relics can be upgraded to +1, +2, +3, improving their stats. Relics are upgraded linearly (first +0 to +1, then +1 to +2, then +2 to +3). If an upgrade fails, the relic DOES NOT decrease its current upgrade level.

Bonus from relic upgrade:
  • +1 = stats increase by 20%
  • +2 = stats increase by 50%
  • +3 = stats increase by 100%
Relic upgrade chance:
  • +1 = success chance 50%
  • +2 = success chance 25%
  • +3 = success chance 12%
To upgrade relics, the resource Relic Parchment is required.
  • There are 6 grades of parchment, corresponding to relic grades. Relic Parchment is not tradable (parchment boxes that drop from PB are tradable).
  • Different relics require different amounts of parchment for upgrading.
  • Relic Parchment can be obtained by crafting from resources or looted from PB or by completing Adventurer Quests.
  • Also, TRADABLE parchment boxes (those dropped from PB) can be listed and bought on the web-auction.
Combinations for creating Relic Parchment:
